title: Dave Rossi's fourth orb in the MH370 videos

tellings.quote: Rossy's fourth orb. That's why Ashton now goes by four orbs.

plain: A man named Dave Rossi is said to have spotted a fourth glowing orb in videos that some say show orbs around MH370, the Malaysian passenger flight lost over Southeast Asia in 2014. A Navy scientist named Salvatore Pais, who holds patents on UFO-like craft, passes this along, adding that it is why another man who studies the videos, Ashton Forbes, "now goes by four orbs." If it held up, the videos would show more around the plane than had been counted before.
